/-!
# Erdős Problem 905

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/905](https://www.erdosproblems.com/905)
- [KhNi79] Khadzhiivanov, N. G. and Nikiforov, S. V., *Solution of a problem of P. Erdős about the
  maximum number of triangles with a common edge in a graph*. C. R. Acad. Bulgare Sci. (1979),
  1315-1318.
-/

namespace Erdos905

open Finset

/--
Every graph with $n$ vertices and $>n^2/4$ edges contains an edge which is in at least $n/6$
triangles.

A conjecture of Bollobás and Erdős. This was proved independently by Edwards (unpublished) and
Khadzhiivanov and Nikiforov [KhNi79].
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5, formal_proof using lean4 at "https://github.com/plby/lean-proofs/blob/main/src/v4.29.1/ErdosProblems/Erdos905.lean"]
theorem erdos_905 (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hG : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / 4 < (#G.edgeFinset : ℝ)) :
    ∃ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, (n : ℝ) / 6 ≤ (#(G.trianglesContaining e) : ℝ) := by
  sorry

end Erdos905

review.notes:
The sole declaration, Erdos905.erdos_905, matches the source's strict edge threshold and non-strict triangle bound. edgeFinset counts unordered edges once; trianglesContaining counts distinct three-vertex cliques containing both endpoints. Its potentially unusual behavior on diagonal pairs is unreachable because the witness must belong to edgeFinset. Fin n and decidable adjacency introduce no mathematical restriction on finite graphs.

Scratch checks prove that the hypothesis is impossible for n ≤ 2 and holds for K₃, verify the real-to-integer inequality translations, and exhaustively test every graph on at most five vertices. These checks compile in /workspace/review/scratch.lean.

The linked proof's final theorem uses natural division, but its stronger helper proves n < 6·maxTriangleDegree. After proof-only compatibility updates from Lean 4.29.1 to the sandbox's 4.33.1, /workspace/review/proof_bridge.lean derives the exact repository statement, including the bijection between common neighbors and triangles. Its axioms are only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The solved/formal-proof metadata agrees with the source.

The original 1979 article's full text was not located; its bibliography was checked, and the exact problem text was verified against the website's LaTeX and Bollobás–Nikiforov's later paper. No declaration's faithfulness remains unsettled.
